_meta.source: Finnish Cancer Registry statistics application, https://tilastot.syoparekisteri.fi/syovat/ (English UI: ?_inputs_&language=%22en%22); data from 2026-04-02, version 2026-04-22-001; licence CC BY 4.0
_meta.cases: mean per year = (Diagnosed cancer cases, tab "Latest 5-year period (2020-2024)") / 5
_meta.deaths: mean per year = (Cancer deaths, tab "Latest 5-year period (2020-2024)") / 5; region = region of residence in year of death
_meta.lateShare: Non-localized / (Localized + Non-localized), unknown stage EXCLUDED from denominator; from preliminary statistics 2021-2025 tab "Cancer stage" (final 2020-2024 stage exists only for whole country). NOT TNM III-IV: registry categories are only Localized / Non-localized / Unknown.
_meta.unknownStageShare: Unknown / all cases in preliminary statistics 2021-2025 (tab Latest 5-year period (2021-2025), which equals the sum of the stage rows), same source as lateShare
_meta.nonLocalizedShareOfAllCases: Non-localized / all cases (unknown in denominator) - a lower bound
_meta.suppression: the registry blanks counts of 1-4; such values are null here (not back-calculated). Where only one of Localized/Non-localized is blanked, lateShareBounds gives the [min,max] lateShare implied by the 1-4 range; lateShare stays null.
_meta.expected: not published by the app; null everywhere
_meta.bowel: C18-C20 (Colon and rectum); C21 anus given separately under anusC21, and casesC18_21/deathsC18_21 sum them
